inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject the edge if Optimus remains demonstration-stage, fixed automation is more economic, repeat paid deployments and safe uptime do not emerge, or manufacturing and component costs prevent durable shareholder returns.
inputs.proposed_mechanism: Repeat paid Optimus deployments could create direct robot revenue and demand for motion, sensing, edge-compute, power and material content, but current spending and prototypes do not establish uptime, customer economics, attributable revenue or margins.

objective: Review whether Tesla has a material causal relationship to humanoid robotics and embodied AI through Optimus deployment and component economics; accept or reject the edge.
